notes.title: Dark Prospect - Early Access release date
notes.notes:
Hello everybody

We are very excited, our second Game [b][i]Dark Prospect [/i][/b] will start Early Access on August 11, 2020.
If you are interested in a FPS/RTS Hybrid, check it out.
[i][b]But please note that in contrast to Chaostower, it is not suitable for children.[/b][/i]

We are looking forward to playing exciting matches with all of you.

We'll see you ingame

Cashcowgames

https://store.steampowered.com/app/604770/Dark_Prospect/

notes.title: more FREE new levels
notes.notes:
With the current update, there will be 3 new levels.

When you start ChaosTower you will see the button - Extra Levels, there we will add more and more crazy levels.

These levels are playable at the very beginning, so make sure you are familiar with all the items (so we recommend to play at least the basic levels of the main game).

Have fun

Cashcowgames
